description: 棕色长发披散，穿灰色绗缝外套，围蓝、黄、红褐色相间的格纹围巾。身体朝侧方，头部转向镜头，画面为上半身构图。围巾遮挡部分颈部和下脸区域，下半身未完整入镜。
description_en: Long brown hair is worn loose. A gray quilted coat and a plaid scarf in blue, yellow, and reddish-brown tones are visible. The body faces sideways while the head turns toward the camera in an upper-body view. The scarf partly obscures the neck and lower face, and the lower body is not fully shown.

subjects.description: 棕色长发披散，穿灰色绗缝外套，围蓝、黄、红褐色相间的格纹围巾。身体朝侧方，头部转向镜头，画面为上半身构图。围巾遮挡部分颈部和下脸区域，下半身未完整入镜。
subjects.description_en: Long brown hair is worn loose. A gray quilted coat and a plaid scarf in blue, yellow, and reddish-brown tones are visible. The body faces sideways while the head turns toward the camera in an upper-body view. The scarf partly obscures the neck and lower face, and the lower body is not fully shown.

limitations: 围巾遮挡部分颈部和下脸区域；下半身未完整入镜。
截图压缩、户外光线及画面中的白色颗粒可能影响颜色和纹理统计。
输入为包含照片的手机截图，照片以人物为主体；统计使用避开手机界面和黑边的区域。
头部和人物区域由 Agent 粗略估计，可能混入背景；没有使用检测器或分割模型。
统计仅保留有损全局计数或加权和，不保留原图、像素、区域定位坐标或空间布局，不生成生物识别模板。
各张图的 p001 仅在该图内有效，不表示已经核验跨图人物身份。
外观描述和图像统计不证明人物记录中的行为、评价或证据等级。
limitations_en: The scarf partly obscures the neck and lower face; the lower body is not fully visible.
Screenshot compression, outdoor lighting, and visible white particles may affect color and texture statistics.
The inputs are mobile screenshots containing photographs centered on a subject. Statistical regions avoid the phone interface and black margins.
Head and visible-person regions are coarse Agent estimates and may include background; no detector or segmentation model was used.
Only lossy global counts or weighted sums are retained. Original images, pixels, region coordinates, spatial layout, and biometric templates are not stored.
Each p001 is local to its own image and does not confirm identity across images.
Appearance descriptions and image statistics do not establish the behavior, evaluations, or evidence grades in the person record.
